name: torchvision (classification)
summary: Truncated reproduction of the torchvision references/classification recipe: resnet18 trained from scratch for 4 epochs (592 optimizer steps) on Imagenette, a 10-class ImageNet subset, reaching top-1 60.13% / top-5 93.78% on the held-out split against the exact checkpoint that was published. No upstream file was modified; the fork adds only a workflow, gitignore rules, two additive scripts beside train.py and one document, so the code path under test is upstream's own. Tier-1 record is green: clean DAG 13/13, AI-BOM 100/100, all artifact URLs public, and a portable freeze with no local-version (+cu) pins. Accuracy climbed 32.8 -> 41.6 -> 51.1 -> 60.1 across the four epochs; the run is deliberately truncated, is not converged, and is not an ImageNet number. Six upstream findings, two of them bugs that break documented flags: train.py pickles the run's argparse.Namespace into every checkpoint but reloads with weights_only=True, so --resume and --test-only --resume cannot read a checkpoint train.py itself just wrote on PyTorch >= 2.6 (a prepared patch is included, verified against a real checkpoint, not submitted); and CosineAnnealingLR is built with an unguarded T_max = epochs - lr_warmup_epochs, so --epochs 1 with the README's own --lr-warmup-epochs 1 cannot start, which is exactly the command a newcomer reaches for first. The script also writes two 89 MB checkpoints per epoch with no flag to ask for fewer, the repository root shadows the installed torchvision so the reference scripts must be invoked by path rather than as -m modules, and a stale egg-info makes importlib.metadata report a version published to no index. One honest caveat on the record itself: the 21 recorded pins cover torch, torchvision, numpy and pillow but omit typing-extensions and tqdm, which the recipe does load. Both are transitive dependencies of torch, so a rebuild reinstalls them and succeeds, but they are present by resolution rather than by observation.

certification.resultCaveat: Tier-1 record only — NOT certified. No cold rebuild has been run. The freeze is also THIN: imports-vs-freeze Tier-A misses are 2 (tqdm, typing-extensions) because roar 0.4.4rc3 over-corrects (P0-28).
